title: Koszul-regular quotient as a derived tensor product
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $r\geq0$, and let $f_1,\ldots,f_r\in R$ be Koszul-regular in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. Let $P=\mathbf Z[x_1,\ldots,x_r]$ map to $R$ by $x_i\mapsto f_i$, let $J=(x_1,\ldots,x_r)\subset P$, let $B=R/(f_1,\ldots,f_r)$, and let $\mathbf Z=P/J$. Then the canonical map $R\otimes_P^{\mathbf L}\mathbf Z\to B[0]$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 08SJ (lemma-mod-regular-sequence), proof: the Koszul resolution of $\mathbf Z$ over $P$ and the Koszul-regularity hypothesis after tensoring with $R$.
